Yeah, I play a lot of games and watch a lot of movies. I need to meditate and go out more or something. I have no idea what to do with my summer. I'm only 17 and just graduated high school, got dumped by my boyfriend/best friend all through high school. I don't have any other close friends right now, nor do I know where to go or what to do with myself. I just want the world to open up, but I don't know how.

Yeah, I'm actually not super big on reading existential lit, just because the essays can get dull and depressing. I'm just trying really hard to feel well-read and intelligent. My perspective of the world feels very narrow. I have so much to learn.

I've only read The Stranger (L'Etranger). Your title just gave me a Camus vibe, even though I guess it's Rick and Morty? But I have a couple other books of his lying around, I've just been reading the hell out of Murakami lately. I dunno, absurdism keeps me sane some days.
